question: Write a short speech script (about 1 minute) to persuade your class about something you care about.
answer: Did you know that one school library book is read by about 30 children before it wears out? That is why I think every student should visit our library at least once a week. First, reading makes you a better writer. Last term I read three adventure books and my story marks went up from a C to a B. Second, the library is free fun. You can borrow comics, science books and even board games without spending any money. So, books make you smarter and they cost nothing. This Friday, come with me at lunch and borrow just one book. You might find your new favourite!

question: Write a short speech script (about 1 minute) to persuade your class about something you care about.
answer: Imagine a playground with no plastic bottles lying around. That could be our school! My message is simple: we should all bring reusable water bottles. One reason is that plastic bottles take hundreds of years to break down, so they stay on Earth longer than we will. Another reason is money. My family saved a lot after we stopped buying bottled water every week. Reusable bottles help the planet and your pocket. Starting Monday, please bring your own bottle and ask a friend to do the same.

question: Write a short speech script (about 1 minute) to persuade your class about something you care about.
answer: Last summer I was scared to jump into the pool, until my swimming coach held my hand and counted to three. That day I learned why everyone should learn to swim. Swimming keeps you safe near rivers and the sea, because you know what to do if you fall in. It is also great exercise. My cousin used to get tired running, but after six months of swimming he can play football for the whole match. Swimming keeps you safe and strong. Ask your parents about lessons this month, and you might jump in like I did!

question: Write a short speech script (about 1 minute) to persuade your class about something you care about.
answer: Today I will talk about why we should have more PE lessons. PE is good for us. It makes us healthy and strong. Also, many children sit at screens all day and do not move enough. More PE would help with that. I think it would be really good for our school. Thank you for listening.

question: Write a short speech script (about 1 minute) to persuade your class about something you care about.
answer: Have you ever been bored at break time? I think our school should have a games club. Games are fun and you can make new friends. My friend Riya joined a chess club and now she has lots of friends. We could play chess, card games, and also video games, and my favourite video game is about building cities, which has amazing graphics and you can build bridges and roads. So that is my speech.

question: Write a short speech script (about 1 minute) to persuade your class about something you care about.
answer: Dogs are the best pets. They are loyal, which means they stay with you and protect you. They are also good for exercise, because you have to walk them every day. My dog Bruno waits for me at the gate every day after school. So if your family is thinking about getting a pet, choose a dog, and visit an animal shelter this weekend to meet one.

question: Write a short speech script (about 1 minute) to persuade your class about something you care about.
answer: Hello everyone. My speech is about saving water. We waste a lot of water when we leave the tap running while brushing our teeth. Water is important for plants, animals and people. Some places in the world do not have enough clean water. We should be careful. In conclusion, saving water is important. Thank you.
